# NeptuneResource

> Domain research archive for Neptune. Literature reviews and primary-source analyses. Curated by Corgan Studio, Inc.

Research Archive: https://neptuneresource.net/research/ (literature reviews by Corgan Studio, Inc., open to read).

## Research Archive

- [Neptune interior heat balance and excess luminosity](https://neptuneresource.net/research/neptune-interior-heat): Review of Neptune's measured 2.6x excess thermal luminosity over absorbed solar flux, the implications for interior structure and convection, and the contrast with Uranus's measured zero or negative excess luminosity.
- [Neptune and Kuiper Belt interaction history](https://neptuneresource.net/research/neptune-kuiper-interaction): Review of the dynamical relationship between Neptune and the Kuiper Belt, including the resonance-trapping populations swept up during Neptune's outward migration, the cold-vs-hot classical Kuiper Belt dichotomy, and the present-day scattered-disc and Centaur supply chain.
- [Neptune storm lifecycles and Great Dark Spot analogs](https://neptuneresource.net/research/neptune-storm-lifecycles): Review of the Voyager 2 Great Dark Spot, the subsequent Hubble and JWST records of comparable transient storms, and the inferred lifetime statistics for Neptune's discrete-vortex weather features.
- [Triton cryovolcanism and polar cap migration](https://neptuneresource.net/research/triton-cryovolcanism): Review of the Voyager 2 cryovolcanism evidence at Triton, the active geyser plumes observed during the 1989 flyby, the seasonal polar cap migration, and the implications for Triton's interior thermal state and capture history.
- [Triton's retrograde orbit: capture mechanism and present-day cryovolcanism](https://neptuneresource.net/research/triton-retrograde-orbit): Review of Triton's anomalous retrograde orbit, the binary-capture model favoured for its origin, and the Voyager 2 evidence for ongoing nitrogen-driven cryovolcanism on a captured Kuiper Belt object.
